coreResponsibility: A PlayKit JS player plugin that displays related video entries in a grid/list UI, enabling end-of-playback recommendations, auto-continue functionality, and contextual content discovery within the Kaltura Player ecosystem.

featureOwnership: Related entries side panel list display
Auto-continue to next related entry after playback ends
Fetch related entries by playlist ID
Fetch related entries by entry list
Fetch related entries by context API (metadata-based)
Show related grid on playback paused
Responsive grid layout based on player size breakpoints
List toggle button in upper bar
dataHandling: Entry metadata and thumbnails (via EntryService and ImageService)
MediaInfo cache map for entry metadata

upstream: Kaltura Player JS (@playkit-js/kaltura-player-js) - Core player instance and BasePlugin class
PlayKit UI Managers (@playkit-js/ui-managers) - SidePanelsManager and UpperBarManager services
Kaltura Backend API - playlist.execute action for context-based related entries (_KDP_CTXPL)
Kaltura Provider - getPlaylistConfig, getEntryListConfig, doRequest methods
downstream: Kaltura Player UI layer - Injects components into GuiArea, OverlayPlaybackControls, BottomBarPlaybackControls, InteractiveArea
Player events system - Dispatches RELATED_OPEN, RELATED_CLOSE, RELATED_ENTRY_SELECTED, RELATED_ENTRY_AUTO_PLAYED, RELATED_GRID_DISPLAYED events
externalApis: Kaltura API playlist.execute action with _KDP_CTXPL context playlist
Kaltura Provider API for entry/playlist metadata fetching
humanize-duration library for localized duration formatting

errorPatterns: failed to get related entries by playlist id
failed to get related entries by entry list
failed to get related entries by context

configurationOptions.autoContinue: boolean - Enable auto-continue to next entry (default: true)
configurationOptions.autoContinueTime: number - Seconds to wait before auto-continue (default: 5)
configurationOptions.showOnPlaybackPaused: boolean - Show grid when paused (default: false)
configurationOptions.playlistId: string - Fetch related by playlist ID
configurationOptions.entryList: MediaInfo[] - Fetch related by entry IDs
configurationOptions.sourcesList: Sources[] - Manual entries without API fetch
configurationOptions.useContext: boolean - Fetch by context API (default: true)
configurationOptions.position: string - Side panel position: top/down/left/right (default: right)
